description:
bch/spec.rs (230dd84d) carries a private integer_gcd (gf2-core keeps gcd_u64 private in field/extension.rs) and a private cyclic_polynomial building x^n - 1. Promote both to public gf2-core surfaces in the FieldPoly::lcm precedent (8f51d6cf) and migrate spec.rs to them. bch-construct-generator, matrix-materialize, and systematic-encode each want the cyclic polynomial helper; gf2-core is the convergent home.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A public gf2-core integer gcd and a public x^n - 1 constructor exist with rustdoc and tests, and bch/spec.rs uses them with its private copies deleted.
- [hard] REQ-02: Workspace tests pass; no behavioral change.
title: Promote integer gcd and the cyclic polynomial x^n-1 helper to gf2-core
